title: Useful things, governed in common
dek: LOCAL STAR COMMONS turns six quality-of-life products into a contribution-governed founding movement
body:
LOCAL STAR COMMONS begins with six useful local-first objects: LOCAL STAR, a desktop satellite, compute, sensor, and mesh hub; AIR, WATER, LIGHT, CARE, and POWER, five companion products aimed at clearer rooms, earlier signals, gentler coordination, and more resilient everyday life. Together they form one product family rather than six disconnected gadgets.

The Commons gives that family an off-chain founding constitution. Five working circles—Product, Field, Care, Stewardship, and Story—move ideas through signal, shape, review, vote, field, and learn. Three proposals begin the work: a public First Field Table, a 25-mile El Segundo pilot ring, and an Open Repair Ledger. Membership grows through visible contribution, and the current site stores participation signals only on the visitor's device.

This release is a direction and coordination prototype, not a legal entity, investment offer, token project, active treasury, fundraising mechanism, binding shared vote, certified hardware program, satellite service, emergency system, or operating physical mesh. PointCast carries the Commons through a canonical interactive route, machine JSON, Block and feed distribution, Press Wire, and a disclosed house-ad creative.
